foundation.chronology: The first response failed; original eyewitness records remain contested.
foundation.moral_problem: Who should control hydroponic nutrients while life-support imbalance destabilizes access?
foundation.causality: No character can claim a recovered source before it is discovered.

premise: Enzo Aster, a trader with expertise in convoy routing, demand elasticity and risk pricing, must reopen commerce without bankrupting roadside communities before life-support imbalance reaches the ring garden habitat.
stakes: Residents lose access to hydroponic nutrients
an exclusionary merchant league gains authority without independent evidence
The ring garden habitat becomes inaccessible beyond rotating arboretums
